outcome: The player moves that many cards from the top of their library to their graveyard.
Milling more cards than the library holds mills the whole library; a cost to mill more than the library holds cannot be paid.
note: The cost-payment half is also a legality verdict.

outcome: A later part of the effect can find the milled card in the graveyard it moved to.
When replacement effects mill several cards, a single-card mill effect queries each milled card and sums or applies to all of them.
